risks.title: Chair resistance to diversity targets
risks.description: The board chair or senior independent director opposes specific diversity targets, viewing them as unwarranted interference with merit-based appointments.
early_warning_signals: Chair questions merit vs targets in kick-off
Chair declines interview or reschedules repeatedly
risks.mitigation: Frame targets as governance best practice with peer and investor evidence; offer voluntary time-bound targets over quotas; secure chair sponsorship early via T007.
risks.contingency: De-escalate to a principles-led framework without numeric targets and document as comply-or-explain.

risks.title: Nomination committee bypassing agreed process
risks.description: The nomination committee reverts to informal, pre-existing appointment habits, ignoring the new diverse-slate and structured-interview process.
early_warning_signals: Committee meetings held without updated charter
risks.mitigation: Embed the process in the updated charter (T042); require criteria documentation for every appointment; build process checks into T064.
risks.contingency: Pause appointments pending process compliance; escalate to chair and sponsor.

risks.title: Board refresh hitting incumbency resistance
risks.description: Long-tenured directors resist staggered retirement or skills-matrix refresh needed to create vacancies for diverse appointments.
risks.mitigation: Use objective skills matrix and succession framework (T029, T045); tie refresh to evaluation and code expectations.
risks.contingency: Phase refresh over a longer horizon and disclose the rationale.

risks.title: Key board sponsor departs during engagement
risks.description: The chair or sponsor who championed the engagement leaves the board mid-engagement, removing the executive air cover.
early_warning_signals: Sponsor signals departure or reduced availability
risks.mitigation: Build a coalition of support across chair, SID, and nomination chair rather than a single sponsor; document decisions formally.
risks.contingency: Re-confirm mandate with successor within one cycle; re-scope if commitment has changed.

risks.title: Succession planning conflicts with diversity targets
risks.description: Incumbent succession choices (e.g. internal CEO promotion, pre-identified successors) reduce the openings available to meet diversity targets.
early_warning_signals: Succession plan names specific internal successors
risks.mitigation: Integrate diversity into succession planning from T045; widen candidate pool; plan staggered refresh.
risks.contingency: Adjust target trajectory and timeframe; document trade-offs transparently.

risks.title: Board evaluation reveals deeper effectiveness issues
risks.description: The evaluation surfaces systemic effectiveness problems (dysfunctional dynamics, poor information quality) that expand scope and delay diversity work.
early_warning_signals: Evaluation notes withheld or heavily redacted
risks.mitigation: Scope diversity and effectiveness as linked workstreams; budget contingency for deeper intervention.
risks.contingency: Sequence effectiveness remediation ahead of diversity acceleration; re-baseline the roadmap.

risks.title: Board data access denied or restricted
risks.description: Board members or legal counsel refuse access to board evaluation results, diversity data, or director information citing confidentiality or legal restrictions.
early_warning_signals: Legal counsel raises concerns at kick-off
Data provided is anonymised to non-useful level
risks.mitigation: Agree data access scope and protocol in Phase 0 (T003, T004) with chair and GC; offer tiered access; use aggregated data where possible.
risks.contingency: Redesign scope to work with public disclosure data only; pivot to a 'what peer companies disclose' benchmarking approach.

risks.title: Diversity data quality poor or incomplete
risks.description: Diversity data is missing, inconsistently categorised, or out of date, undermining benchmarking and target-setting.
early_warning_signals: Data older than the last AGM
risks.mitigation: Apply the two-source rule (T012); document data quality and assumptions; flag low-confidence metrics.
risks.contingency: Use qualitative triangulation from interviews where quantitative data is weak; extend discovery.

risks.title: Intersectionality data unavailable
risks.description: Data needed for intersectional analysis (gender x ethnicity x age) is not collected or not disclosable, preventing an intersectional view.
risks.mitigation: Agree a minimum intersectional dataset in Phase 0; use aggregated reporting thresholds to protect anonymity.
risks.contingency: Report available dimensions with explicit caveats and a plan to improve data collection (T070).

risks.title: Confidentiality breach of sensitive board data
risks.description: Sensitive board data (evaluations, succession candidates) is inadvertently shared or exposed outside the agreed ring-fence.
early_warning_signals: Requests to share board data externally
risks.mitigation: Enforce the confidentiality protocol (T004); use access-controlled storage; minimise and aggregate; train the team.
risks.contingency: Activate incident response; notify GC and sponsor; contain and review controls.

risks.title: Lack of baseline composition data
risks.description: No validated baseline of current board composition exists, blocking meaningful diagnosis and progress measurement.
early_warning_signals: Companies House data out of date
risks.mitigation: Build and validate the baseline early (T012) using the two-source rule; treat data gaps as risks.
risks.contingency: Re-baseline once data is available and re-state all subsequent comparisons.

risks.title: GDPR / data protection breach with diversity data
risks.description: Handling special-category diversity data (e.g. ethnicity) breaches data protection law, exposing the client and engagement to regulatory action.
risks.mitigation: Complete a data protection assessment with GC (T004); minimise collection; aggregate; define retention.
risks.contingency: Halt processing; engage DPO; remediate and notify the supervisory authority if required.

risks.title: Regulatory changes mid-engagement
risks.description: New or revised regulation (e.g. listing-rule changes, ESRS revisions) shifts obligations during the engagement, invalidating parts of the roadmap.
risks.mitigation: Scan the landscape continuously (T010); build a regulatory change register; design the roadmap to be adaptable.
risks.contingency: Run a regulatory impact assessment (T088) and re-sequence the roadmap to absorb changes.

risks.title: Legal challenge to diversity policy
risks.description: The diversity policy or appointment process faces a legal challenge (e.g. discrimination, quota legality) that halts or forces redesign.
risks.mitigation: Legal review of policy wording (T060); prefer voluntary targets over quotas; ensure merit-based criteria.
risks.contingency: Suspend challenged provisions; re-issue a legally compliant version; manage communications.

risks.title: International diversity standard fragmentation
risks.description: Conflicting diversity standards across jurisdictions complicate policy for multinational or dual-listed clients.
risks.mitigation: Map all applicable regimes (T010); design a policy that meets the strictest and discloses variances.
risks.contingency: Adopt entity-level policies tailored to each listing while retaining a common principles base.

risks.title: ESG rating agency methodology changes
risks.description: ESG rating or proxy advisor methodology changes alter how the client's diversity is scored, affecting reputation and investor perception.
risks.mitigation: Track major rating and proxy methodologies; align disclosures to common frameworks (T050).
risks.contingency: Engage rating agencies to clarify; adjust disclosure to address new metrics.

risks.title: Disclosure non-compliance penalties
risks.description: Failure to meet mandatory diversity disclosure requirements leads to regulatory censure, fines, or audit qualification.
early_warning_signals: Late or incomplete annual report data
risks.mitigation: Use the regulatory compliance roadmap (T051) and disclosure framework (T050); pre-clear with auditors.
risks.contingency: Issue a corrective disclosure and comply-or-explain statement; remediate controls.

risks.title: Listing-rule or FCA rule change impacts targets
risks.description: Changes to listing rules (e.g. new FCA diversity disclosure rules) materially change required targets or disclosures.
risks.mitigation: Maintain horizon scanning (T010); build flexibility into target dates and disclosure templates.
risks.contingency: Re-baseline targets and disclosures to the new rule; communicate the change to the board.

risks.title: Target-setting backlash (quotas vs voluntary)
risks.description: Internal or external stakeholders react negatively to perceived quotas, undermining the credibility of targets.
early_warning_signals: Media commentary framing targets as quotas
risks.mitigation: Use a defensible target-setting methodology (T043); communicate voluntary, time-bound, merit-based intent.
risks.contingency: Reframe targets and engage critics; adjust language and evidence base.

risks.title: Candidate pipeline insufficient for targets
risks.description: The pool of board-ready diverse candidates is too small to support the agreed targets within the timeframe.
risks.mitigation: Invest in pipeline (T046, T065); use multiple search firms and networks; lower barriers via mentorship/sponsorship.
risks.contingency: Extend the target timeframe; widen eligibility criteria; disclose progress candidly.

risks.title: Target miss not addressed or explained
risks.description: A diversity target is missed without a credible explanation, breaching comply-or-explain and damaging credibility.
early_warning_signals: Tracking shows shortfall with no action
risks.mitigation: Track targets with variance triggers (T078); prepare comply-or-explain narratives in advance.
risks.contingency: Issue a transparent explanation with a remediation plan and revised trajectory.

risks.title: Tokenistic single appointment
risks.description: A single diverse appointment is made to satisfy a threshold without genuine integration, inviting tokenism criticism.
risks.mitigation: Avoid single-appointment optics; build pipeline and inclusion; support the appointee.
risks.contingency: Reinforce with a second planned appointment and visible inclusion support.

risks.title: Glass cliff appointment risk
risks.description: A diverse candidate is appointed into a crisis, shrinking-board, or high-turnover context that elevates failure risk (the glass cliff).
early_warning_signals: Appointment coincides with profit warning or board shrinkage
risks.mitigation: Screen appointment context against glass-cliff indicators (T083); ensure support and stability; stagger risk.
risks.contingency: Postpone or restructure the role to reduce cliff exposure; provide mentorship and visible backing.

risks.title: Search firm lacks diverse networks
risks.description: The appointed executive search firm draws from narrow networks, limiting the diversity of the candidate slate.
risks.mitigation: Qualify search firms on diverse sourcing (procurement checklist); require diverse slates; use multiple firms.
risks.contingency: Switch or supplement search partners; source directly via networks and pipeline.

risks.title: Investor stewardship pressure shifts priorities
risks.description: Major investors or stewardship teams redirect priorities away from (or into) board diversity, changing the political context.
risks.mitigation: Maintain ongoing investor engagement (T056, T057); align with stewardship codes.
risks.contingency: Re-baseline stakeholder expectations; adjust engagement emphasis without diluting targets.

risks.title: Shareholder backlash at AGM
risks.description: Shareholders vote against or abstain on board diversity-related resolutions at the AGM.
risks.mitigation: Pre-engage major shareholders and proxy advisors (T056, T057); align proposals with voting policies.
risks.contingency: Engage dissenting shareholders; refine proposals for the next cycle; disclose commitments.

risks.title: Investor pressure for binding quotas
risks.description: Investors push for binding quotas that exceed the client's appetite or legal comfort.
risks.mitigation: Present a credible voluntary target trajectory (T043); evidence pipeline and progress.
risks.contingency: Negotiate a time-bound voluntary commitment that satisfies investor expectations without legal quota.

risks.title: Board chair not engaged as sponsor
risks.description: The board chair does not actively sponsor the engagement, weakening authority and pace.
risks.mitigation: Secure chair sponsorship explicitly in T007; route decisions through the chair on a fixed cadence.
risks.contingency: Escalate to SID or nominate committee chair as co-sponsor; reconfirm mandate.

risks.title: Employee and forum resistance to DEI
risks.description: Employee groups or works councils resist the board-level DEI agenda or perceive it as performative.
risks.mitigation: Pair board work with authentic organisation-wide signals; communicate honestly; involve forums.
risks.contingency: Hold listening sessions; adjust communications; demonstrate concrete actions.

risks.title: Proxy advisor adverse voting recommendation
risks.description: A major proxy advisor issues an adverse recommendation on board composition or diversity at the AGM.
risks.mitigation: Meet proxy thresholds; pre-engage advisors (T057); improve disclosure clarity.
risks.contingency: Publish commitments and trajectory; engage advisors directly to clarify.

risks.title: Cultural resistance to DEI initiatives
risks.description: Entrenched board or organisational culture resists DEI initiatives, slowing or hollowing out implementation.
risks.mitigation: Lead with leadership modelling; tie to evaluation and objectives; design inclusion guidelines (T049).
risks.contingency: Slow the rollout; invest in leadership alignment before scaling.

risks.title: Mentorship programme low uptake
risks.description: The board mentorship programme attracts too few mentors or mentees to build the pipeline.
risks.mitigation: Recruit visible senior champions; reduce friction to join; track and nudge participation.
risks.contingency: Redesign the offer; widen eligibility; reconsider format or incentives.

risks.title: Sponsorship programme inequitable or ineffective
risks.description: The sponsorship programme fails to advocate effectively or is perceived as inequitable, undermining its purpose.
risks.mitigation: Define sponsor accountability (T048); broaden the candidate pool; monitor outcomes.
risks.contingency: Reset sponsor assignments; introduce transparent criteria and review.

risks.title: Unrealistic expectations on speed of change
risks.description: Stakeholders expect rapid board composition change that the 6-12 month appointment cycle cannot deliver.
early_warning_signals: Pressure for appointments within a quarter
risks.mitigation: Educate stakeholders on the appointment cycle early; set realistic phased targets (T043).
risks.contingency: Re-phase expectations; emphasise leading indicators (pipeline, process) alongside outcomes.

risks.title: Policy adoption delayed beyond AGM cycle
risks.description: Policy adoption slips past the AGM, deferring disclosure and external commitments by a full year.
risks.mitigation: Lock adoption to the AGM cycle (T063); front-load legal review; maintain a critical-path view.
risks.contingency: Interim board resolution with full disclosure at the next AGM; communicate the slip transparently.

risks.title: Board evaluation findings ignored
risks.description: Evaluation findings are not acted upon, reducing the effectiveness of the whole engagement.
risks.mitigation: Tie findings to owners and milestones; report progress to the board (T080).
risks.contingency: Escalate unaddressed findings to chair; integrate into next evaluation and roadmap.

risks.title: Glass cliff accusations in media
risks.description: Media or commentators accuse the company of appointing a woman or minority director into a glass-cliff position.
risks.mitigation: Screen appointments for glass-cliff context (T083); ensure stable, supported roles; prepare messaging.
risks.contingency: Issue a fact-based response; demonstrate support structures; engage critics constructively.

risks.title: Tokenism perception damaging reputation
risks.description: Appointments are perceived as tokenistic, damaging the company's reputation for authentic diversity.
risks.mitigation: Build genuine pipeline and inclusion; communicate merit and process; avoid isolated appointments.
risks.contingency: Reinforce with visible, supported succession and transparent process.

risks.title: Adverse media scrutiny of board composition
risks.description: Media or campaigners publicly criticise the board's composition, triggering reputational pressure.
risks.mitigation: Maintain credible progress and disclosure; pre-prepare factual briefings.
risks.contingency: Respond with evidence of trajectory and commitments; brief board and investors.

risks.title: Greenwashing: client overstates diversity progress
risks.description: The client overstates diversity progress in external reporting relative to internal reality, creating greenwashing exposure.
early_warning_signals: Pressure to present targets as achieved
risks.mitigation: Reconcile external disclosure against validated internal data (T073); legal review; honest comply-or-explain.
risks.contingency: Correct the disclosure; issue clarification; review disclosure governance.

risks.title: Public scrutiny or activist pressure
risks.description: Activist investors or campaigners pressure the company publicly on board diversity.
risks.mitigation: Maintain credible trajectory and engagement; pre-empt with strong disclosure.
risks.contingency: Engage activists; reinforce commitments; consider board dialogue.

risks.title: Reputational fallout from a failed diverse appointment
risks.description: A high-profile diverse appointment departs quickly or underperforms, reinforcing negative stereotypes and harming reputation.
risks.mitigation: Strong onboarding, mentoring, and inclusion support; avoid cliff appointments.
risks.contingency: Conduct an exit review; address root causes; communicate learnings honestly.

risks.title: Timeline too short for board appointment cycle
risks.description: The engagement timeline does not accommodate the 6-12 month board appointment cycle, making outcome targets undeliverable.
early_warning_signals: Targets tied to a single AGM
No room for search and onboarding
risks.mitigation: Design realistic timelines around the appointment cycle (T043, T066); use phased targets.
risks.contingency: Re-baseline the timeline; reframe success around leading indicators until the cycle completes.

risks.title: Budget constraints limiting candidate search
risks.description: Budget limits restrict the breadth or quality of executive search, narrowing the candidate pool.
risks.mitigation: Prioritise search spend on impact; use multiple lower-cost channels; leverage pipeline.
risks.contingency: Re-phase search; source via networks and partnerships; extend timeline.

risks.title: Scope creep beyond board to workforce DEI
risks.description: Scope expands from board diversity into organisation-wide workforce DEI, overloading the engagement.
early_warning_signals: Requests to cover all workforce diversity
risks.mitigation: Define board vs workforce scope clearly in T005; manage change control rigorously.
risks.contingency: Stage a separate workforce DEI workstream with its own scope and budget.

risks.title: Key advisor personnel leave engagement
risks.description: Loss of key engagement personnel (e.g. lead governance advisor, data analyst) disrupts continuity and knowledge.
risks.mitigation: Document work thoroughly; cross-train; maintain continuity through handover packs.
risks.contingency: Backfill quickly; prioritise knowledge transfer; brief replacement on client context.

risks.title: Annual report deadline clash delays disclosure
risks.description: Clashing reporting deadlines delay the diversity disclosure or force a rushed, lower-quality submission.
early_warning_signals: Data packs delivered close to deadline
risks.mitigation: Lock disclosure into the reporting calendar early (T073); automate data packs (T071).
risks.contingency: Defer non-essential content; prioritise mandatory disclosure; communicate with auditors.

risks.title: Engagement ROI questioned by client
risks.description: The client questions the value or cost of the engagement, risking early termination or non-renewal.
risks.mitigation: Demonstrate value through tangible milestones and KPI dashboards (T075); regular checkpoint reviews.
risks.contingency: Reconfirm value proposition; re-scope to highest-impact, lowest-cost elements.
